children: Incannex Healthcare Inc. reported fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $0 and a net loss of ($19.3M), narrowing from a ($46.89M) loss in the prior year; diluted loss per share was ($1.66) versus ($40.82) in fiscal 2025.
¹ Reported as “Revenue from customers”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Clinical milestones: completed Phase 2 RePOSA for IHL-42X with observed AHI reduction and tolerability; initiated Phase 2 DReAMzz dose-confirmation in May 2026.

Pipeline diversification: advancing three programs— IHL-42X (obstructive sleep apnea), PSX-001 (psilocybin for generalized anxiety disorder), and IHL-675A (inflammation)—with priority on IHL-42X and PSX-001.
Regulatory momentum: FDA granted Fast Track designation for IHL-42X in December 2025; IND cleared for PSX-001. DReAMzz results will inform Phase 3 design.
Spending and operations: R&D expense declined about 52% year-over-year due to trial timing, while G&A rose 36% driven by stock-based compensation and expanded management support.
Liquidity: cash increased materially, providing at least 12 months of runway from the report date to support near-term trials and operations.
